name: modal
title: Modal
description: Dialogs with a header, scrolling body and action footer, plus fixed-footer and bottom-sheet variants.
improvements: Built on Radix Dialog: role="dialog", aria-labelledby/aria-describedby, focus trap and focus returned to the trigger.
Overlays are removed with their modal, so no stray overlay is left behind (#1647).
Nested modals stack by open order, without a global z-index counter.
Scroll lock compensates for the scrollbar width and works on iOS Safari.
dismissible and preventScrolling are reactive props, and open state can be controlled.
